# Indeed

> Indeed is a global employment platform for job seekers and employers, offering job search, hiring tools, career guidance, and workplace insights.

Indeed provides resources for both sides of the hiring market: job seekers can search jobs, build resumes, research companies, and explore career advice, while employers can post jobs, sponsor listings, manage applicants, and access recruiting guidance. The site also includes salary data, company reviews, and extensive help content.

## Job Search
- [Find Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/jobs): Search open roles by title, keyword, company, and location.
- [Remote Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/q-Remote-jobs.html): Browse remote and work-from-home job listings across industries.
- [Part Time Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/q-Part-Time-jobs.html): Explore part-time opportunities in a wide range of fields.
- [Full Time Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/q-Full-Time-jobs.html): Browse full-time positions across locations and experience levels.
- [Company Reviews](https://www.indeed.com/companies): Research employers through ratings, reviews, and workplace information.
- [Career Advice](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice): Read articles on resumes, interviews, pay, and career development.

## Career Resources
- [Career Guide](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/career-development): Learn about career growth, planning, and professional development.
- [Resume Help](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/resumes-cover-letters): Get guidance on resumes, cover letters, and application materials.
- [Interviewing Guide](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/interviewing): Prepare for interviews with practical tips and example questions.
- [Pay and Salary](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/pay-salary): Understand compensation, negotiation, and salary-related topics.
- [Starting a New Job](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/starting-new-job): Find advice for onboarding, transitions, and early job success.
- [Career Paths](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/finding-a-job): Explore job search strategies and role discovery resources.

## Salary & Company Insights
- [Browse Salaries](https://www.indeed.com/career/salaries): Explore salary estimates by job title and location.
- [Company Reviews](https://www.indeed.com/companies): Compare employers using employee ratings and reviews.
- [Work Happiness](https://www.indeed.com/cmp): Access employer profiles with culture, benefits, and workplace insights.
- [Hiring Lab](https://www.hiringlab.org/): Read labor market research and workforce trend analysis from Indeed.
- [Career Explorer](https://www.indeed.com/career): Discover occupations, pay data, and career trajectories.
- [Find Companies](https://www.indeed.com/companies/browse-companies): Browse company profiles and employer information.

## Resume & Profile Tools
- [Resume Builder](https://www.indeed.com/create-resume): Create a resume using Indeed’s online resume builder.
- [Upload Resume](https://www.indeed.com/profile/upload-resume): Upload an existing resume for faster applications.
- [Profile](https://www.indeed.com/profile): Manage your Indeed profile, resume, and job seeker preferences.
- [My Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/myjobs): Track saved jobs, applications, and job search activity.
- [Job Alerts](https://www.indeed.com/preferences): Manage job alert and communication preferences.
- [Sign In](https://secure.indeed.com/account/login): Access your Indeed account and personalized job search tools.

## Employer Hiring Solutions
- [Post a Job](https://www.indeed.com/hire/post-job): Create and publish a job listing for applicants.
- [Employer Home](https://www.indeed.com/hire): Access Indeed’s employer hiring products and recruiting tools.
- [Sponsored Jobs](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/sponsored-jobs): Learn how sponsored listings increase job visibility and applicant flow.
- [Smart Sourcing](https://www.indeed.com/hire/smart-sourcing): Search candidate profiles and proactively reach potential hires.
- [Indeed Resume](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resume-search): Search resumes and candidate profiles for recruiting.
- [Company Pages](https://www.indeed.com/hire/company-pages): Build an employer brand presence on Indeed.

## Employer Resources
- [Hiring Resources Hub](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources): Browse employer articles, guides, and recruiting best practices.
- [How-to Hub](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub): Find practical hiring guides for common recruiting tasks.
- [Recruiting Strategies](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/recruiting-strategies): Learn tactics for sourcing, screening, and hiring candidates.
- [Job Description Templates](https://www.indeed.com/hire/job-description): Use templates and examples for writing job descriptions.
- [Interview Questions](https://www.indeed.com/hire/interview-questions): Review interview questions by role and hiring scenario.
- [Hiring Process](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/hiring-process): Improve workflows for screening, interviewing, and onboarding.

## Help & Support
- [Job Seeker Help Center](https://support.indeed.com/hc/en-us): Get support for applications, accounts, and job search issues.
- [Employer Help Center](https://support.indeed.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001242132): Find help for posting jobs, billing, and employer accounts.
- [Indeed Support Home](https://support.indeed.com/): Access support articles and troubleshooting resources.
- [Employer FAQs](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/faq): Read frequently asked questions about Indeed hiring products.
- [Contact Us](https://support.indeed.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit a support request to Indeed.
- [Accessibility at Indeed](https://www.indeed.com/accessibility): Review accessibility information and accommodations support.

## Developers & Integrations
- [Indeed Apply](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/indeed-apply): Learn about applying to jobs directly through Indeed.
- [ATS Integrations](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/ats): Understand applicant tracking system integrations with Indeed.
- [XML Feed Guidelines](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/xml-feed): Review guidance for submitting jobs via XML feeds.
- [Employer Products](https://www.indeed.com/hire/products): Explore Indeed hiring products and recruiting solutions.
- [Hiring Events](https://www.indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/hiring-events): Learn about virtual and in-person hiring event tools.
- [Assessments](https://www.indeed.com/hire/assessments): Evaluate candidates using Indeed Assessments.

- [About Indeed](https://www.indeed.com/about): Learn about Indeed’s mission, company, and global operations.
- [Press Room](https://www.indeed.com/press): Read company announcements and media resources.
- [Privacy Center](https://www.indeed.com/legal): Access privacy, legal, and policy information.
